summary: Dorman Products filed an 8-K regarding a $450M private placement of 6.250% Senior Notes due 2034, issued at par with semi-annual interest, to repay existing credit facility debt and for general corporate purposes. The offering, conducted under Rule 144A/Reg S, is expected to close June 16, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No ownership change, premium, or strategic event is present.
